description: Sabaragamuwa  Provincial Council   -  By-Laws of Kuruwila  Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval and enactment of a by-law regulating dangerous and unpleasant businesses within the Kuruwita Pradeshiya Sabha area. It establishes legal requirements, licensing procedures, and regulatory compliance standards for business operations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions the Governor's approval, this is part of the legal enactment process rather than a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
